children: CDW completed a registered multi-tranche senior notes offering totaling $1.5 billion, including $600 million of 5.700% notes due 2029, $500 million of 6.100% notes due 2032, and $400 million of 6.350% notes due 2033. The notes were sold at issue prices of 99.908%, 100.000%, and 99.805% of par, respectively, and are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by CDW Corporation. Interest accrues from Sep 21, 2026, with first payments due Jan 15, 2027 or Mar 21, 2027 as applicable. Each series includes customary make-whole redemption features before its par call date and is callable at 100% on or after the applicable par call date, under indentures with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee.
